main_text.head: Cap. 37. De anomalis in μι, speciei 2.
main_text.p: 1. εἰμὶ fum, penultima non circumflexa, quamvis in difyllabo longa: fed per ⟨?⟩, & ultima gravi.
ἐσμέν, ἐστέ, εἰσί. Sic ἔνδσον infunt.
Sing. 1 Dorice ἐμμί, Æolice ἤμι. 2 εἶς, vel poetice ἐσί. plur. 1. poet. ἐμμὲν & εἰμμέν: Dorice εἰμές. 2 poet. ἐτέ. 3 Ionice ἔασι: Dor. ἐντί: Æolice ἔσι.
Sing. Ionice ἐω, ἐης, ἐη, vel ἐνοι, vel ἦοι: Poetice εἰώ, εἰής, εἰή. Sing. 2 Æolice ἦ-σθα fis. 1 plur. poetice εἰωμὲν & εἰόμεν.

page.notes: Greek accents and breathings are uncertain in several places (marked by the scan's faded print); the text is a close reading of a damaged page. The line "3. εἶζω" is partly cut off at the right edge.
